title.rendered: Hang Up My Rock and Roll Shoes

content.rendered:
Chuck Willis passed away in 1958 just as he was reaching the pinnacle of his career, so he never got to see “Hang Up My Rock and Roll Shoes” become a hit and an enduring classic.

Many artists have kept the song alive, Bruce among them. Bruce performed the song three times over his career. Here’s the first time, in 1978, on the Darkness on the Edge of Town Tour in Saginaw:

…and the most recent time, fittingly, during the very last show of the Working on a Dream Tour in Buffalo:

And keeping the classics alive, here’s the Chuck Willis original from 1958.

Hang Up My Rock and Roll Shoes
First performed: September 3, 1978 (Saginaw, MI)
Last performed: November 22, 2009 (Buffalo, NY)

© May 13, 2018

excerpt.rendered: Bruce has covered this Chuck Willis classic from 1958 three times over his career. Listen to the first and watch the last inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: September 3
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Guest stars galore in DC, a surprise outdoor jam in Sea Bright, and a Labor Day special in Philly lead off the many highlights from this date in Springsteen history.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Where the Band Was: Buffalo, November 22, 2009
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: No one could have known that this was Clarence's final show. But it almost seems like Bruce did, because it's hard to imagine a more fitting tribute to their friendship.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll Over Beethoven
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce covered it several times over the years, as far back as 1971--but it took until 2009 before a taper could capture Bruce covering Chuck Berry's seminal classic, "Roll Over Beethoven."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Good Rockin’ Tonight
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Throughout the Darkness Tour, Bruce often announced his arrival with the song that announced the arrival of rock itself.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Around and Around
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Many, many times--but almost always in small clubs: Bruce rocks the house with a cover of Chuck Berry's classic B-side, "Around and Around."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Sweet Little Sixteen
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Watch a great pro-shot video of Bruce covering Chuck Berry's classic 20 years after its release.
